"Privacy Policy — flowride App Last Updated: June 7, 2026
1. Introduction flowride App respects your privacy. This policy explains our handling of data and permissions.
2. Data We Collect We only collect the basic data necessary to create your account and log in: • Name • Phone number • Email address • Password (encrypted and never readable)
3. What We Do NOT Collect Except for the account data mentioned above, we do NOT collect, store, or share any other data, including: • Location data • Screen content or trip data • Any other sensitive data
4. Accessibility Service Our app uses the Accessibility Service API solely to read and analyze screen content (trip price and destination) within active work apps. This helps drivers evaluate trips without distraction. This data is processed locally on your device and is never sent to any external server. We do not change user settings or bypass Android privacy controls. We do not collect any data from other apps or send it to external servers. We do not monitor your activity outside the context of ride offers.
5. Overlay Permission Used to display a floating assistant tool over work apps to enhance road safety and reduce app switching while driving.
6. Data Security Passwords are fully encrypted and never readable. Trip evaluation data is processed locally on your device only and is never sent to our servers.
7. Delete Your Data You can request deletion of your account data (name, phone, email, password) at any time via the following link: Data deletion link: https://driver.zakkyai.com/flowride_delete.html Or contact us directly via email.
8. Children's Privacy The app does not target anyone under the age of 16 and we do not collect any data from them.
9. Changes to This Policy We may update this policy from time to time. Any changes will be posted on this page with an updated revision date.
10. Contact Us For any privacy concerns or to request data deletion, contact us at: Email: info@tek-toolai.com App: flowride
© 2026 flowride App"
